subject: Elevator notice?
text: I have a quick question. The building notice changed. The elevator shut-off moved. It is now tomorrow. Not Friday. That is time-sensitive. You manage the office project. I live downstairs. I need access after 6 p.m. The new work order says 4 p.m. Is that final? Can I get a 6 p.m. badge code? I know plans move fast. Your team posted it late. I did not see it before. Could you check? I need a yes or no by noon. The movers arrive then. I can wait if needed. But I must ask now. Sorry for the pressure.
